text:
alex: noticed a spike in scim deprov failures after last night's KMS alias rotation. ~10 accounts ended up with empty external_id. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: which rotation job? rotate-2026-03-19?

alex: rotate-2026-03-19. deprov logs show decrypt errors then worker sets external_id to "" and continues. snippet: 
```
2026-03-19T23:42:01Z ERROR scim/deprov: decrypt extid failed id=svc-14a2 err=invalid_jwe_header kms_alias=rotate-2026-03-19
2026-03-19T23:42:01Z INFO scim/deprov: cleared external_id id=svc-14a2 reason=decrypt_failed
```

jordan: oh, we added that fallback last quarter to avoid backpressure during decrypt storms. shouldn't have been clearing the field though. The intent was to NOP and queue for manual review.

toni: policy check: clearing extid without an audit event violates compliance for deprovisioning. We need an immediate mitigation.

amelia (ops): we can repoint alias to the previous key id quickly if that's the fastest path to let the existing decrypt code succeed.

maria: good. before ops does anything, can we confirm backups? any pre-deprov encrypted extid copies in object storage?

alex: yes, scim-extid-backups has snapshots for each account taken at provision time. We can restore if alias rollback happens.

jordan: root cause: the rotation tool emitted a different envelope (no JWE header fields) and our decrypt lib treats that as invalid_jwe_header. KMS itself returned success but payload format mismatch.

toni: mitigation plan: 1) ops repoint alias -> old-key-id 2) pause scim-deprov consumers 3) restore external_id from backups for affected ids 4) update worker to never drop extid and emit audit + metric on decrypt failure 5) add smoke decrypt step to rotation runbook.

amelia (ops): applying alias re-point now, will message when complete.

--- 8 minutes later ---

amelia (ops): alias rotate-2026-03-19 now points to key-old-ff12. Verified decrypt of sample backup payloads succeeds.

alex: paused scim-deprov-prod queue and ran restore script against S3. restorable ids: svc-14a2 svc-0f9b svc-cc33 etc. Restored 10 accounts.

jordan: opened PR #501 to change deprov handler: on decrypt failure, write audit event and enqueue a manual-review ticket instead of clearing external_id. Added unit tests.

toni: added alert rule scim.deprov.decrypt_failures > 3 in 5m -> pager. Also updated compliance checklist: rotation must include backwards-compatible envelope or post-rotate smoke decrypt.

amelia (ops): restarted scim-deprov-prod worker (run r-2026-03-19-07). Monitoring shows no new decrypt_failures in 30m.

maria: filing a short incident note: INC-2026-0319-kms-envelope-mismatch. Impact: 10 orphaned service accounts recovered. Action items assigned.

alex: thanks. I'll follow up with a small DB migration to add a boolean flag `external_id_protected` to avoid accidental clears and an audit migration to capture the restore events.

jordan: also adding a fuzz test to the rotation pipeline to verify JWE header compatibility.

--- end thread ---
